title: The multivariate-POI matrix-tilt outer ceiling need not be quasiconvex
statement: For d_psi=d_lambda=2, the centered equal-weight table of the eight rows +/-2e_j with K=N=8 has one nonempty singleton partition and outer objective f(B)=log det(I_2+B B^T). At B_0=diag(4,0), B_1=diag(0,4), and their midpoint diag(2,2), the exact determinants are 17,17,25. Thus f(midpoint)>max(f(B_0),f(B_1)), so the outer map is not quasiconvex and hence not convex in general.
assumptions: d_psi=d_lambda=2; K=N=8; positive equal weights; exactly K nonempty cells
the inner D value is evaluated exactly; log monotonicity reduces the comparison to rational determinants

audited: V(B)=I_2+BB^T was re-derived by direct evaluation of the tilted form from the raw rows; a smaller uncentered 4-row, K=4 integer witness of the midpoint violation exists (audit artifact tierb.json) and the registered centered isotropic fixture is kept as canonical
